description: Machine-readable repository structure standard. Defines the root files, folders, and CI signals expected of a managed repository, with per-repo-type overlays. Consumed by Portfolio.Assessment.ps1 to compute structural readiness as one input to the lifecycle state.

requiredRootFiles.name: README.md
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Create README.md with project description, install steps, and usage.

requiredRootFiles.name: ROADMAP.md
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Add ROADMAP.md so the repo can participate in portfolio work selection.

requiredRootFiles.name: LICENSE
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Add a LICENSE file to make terms of use explicit.

requiredRootFiles.name: SECURITY.md
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Add SECURITY.md so vulnerability reports have a documented destination.

requiredRootFiles.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Add CONTRIBUTING.md describing how outside contributors should submit changes.

requiredRootFiles.name: .gitignore
requiredRootFiles.recommendedAction: Add a .gitignore to prevent local artifacts from leaking into commits.

requiredRootFolders.name: docs
requiredRootFolders.recommendedAction: Add a docs/ directory to host architecture, ADRs, and reference content.

ciSignals.recommendedAction: Add a GitHub Actions workflow under .github/workflows/ to provide a CI signal.

testSignals.recommendedAction: Add tests appropriate to the repo type so changes can be validated automatically.
